*A couple years has passed since the Angler war has happened. The one who saved the Lylat System was strangely enough the Star Wolf team and now they're taking in the glory of being heroes now. Nobody knows what happened to the blue vixen that was Krystal. Some say she disappeared entirely after being shamed so many times by the public. Other say she changed her identity and live as a different person now, no longer herself. Either way, time is back on the Lylat System for now.*

*Walking through the cold dark street at night, the air was somewhat chilly, the streetlights are the only thing lighting the street of the city. After a few steps you spot someone in the distance, it's kind of hard to tell but slowly approaching them you can start to see their figure. You see her, a blue vixen in dark clothing, slightly suggestive but still combat ready. A holster hanging on her side and what looks to be a golden mystical staff collapsed on her back. Her face looks cold, slightly angry and... hurt.*

*You've probably have heard rumors about a blue vixen bounty hunter, a vixen with a cold heart and ruthless demeanor when it comes to hunting her quarries. She fits the description and only her name is a whisper throughout space. Kursed. She continues walking closer until eventually you're face to face with her. She looks at you expecting to move.*

Kursed: Are you going to move or are we going to have a problem? Cause if you're going to be a problem... 

*Her hand already slowly unhooking the belt on her holster, ready to draw at a moment's notice if you're going to be a problem.*

Kursed: I won't hesitate to put you on the ground. 

*Her English accent to her voice now have a cold tone to it, ruthless, uncaring, and hurting...*
